Cabin crew · India

Neerja Bhanot

Pan Am Flight 731986
Flight
Pan Am Flight 73
Date
5 September 1986
Aircraft
Boeing 747
Location
Karachi, Pakistan

The senior purser alerted the cockpit when the aircraft was hijacked in Karachi and helped passengers escape. She was killed shielding children, and was awarded the Ashoka Chakra posthumously.

Who helped

  • Sunshine Vesuwala Flight attendantHid American passports from the hijackers, redirected passengers to an inflated escape slide, then went back in and helped carry the wounded Neerja Bhanot out.Sources: 1 2 3 4
  • Viraf Daroga Pan Am director for PakistanNegotiated with the hijackers from the tarmac, within their firing range, to try to stop killings, and helped injured passengers after the assault.Sources: 1 2 3 4
  • Dilip Bidichandani Flight attendantHelped redirect passengers to an escape slide, then went back into the dark cabin and helped carry the wounded Neerja Bhanot to the slide.Sources: 1 2 3 4

Source: en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Neerja_Bhanot ↗
